name: Witch Doctor Amphibimorph makes a frogged humanoid a Beast
contract: Amphibimorph 500952: 'While transformed into a frog the enemy is considered a Beast.' (aura tooltip
'Polymorphed. Beast.'). Effect[0] is aura 56 SPELL_AURA_TRANSFORM (creature 216377), Effect[1] aura 60,
Effect[2] aura 33, all TARGET_UNIT_DEST_AREA_ENEMY 8 yd; 1000 ms cast, no global cooldown, 18% base mana,
RecoveryTime 120000. The only server meaning of a creature type is a target check such as
TargetCreatureType: Unit::GetCreatureType read the creature template type for a creature and ignored the
frog, so Scare Beast 1513 (TargetCreatureType 1 = Beast, 1500 ms cast, 2% base mana) stayed refused with
SPELL_FAILED_BAD_TARGETS (12) at a frogged Kobold Vermin 6 (Humanoid) in the cycle 9 sweep (12 before and
12 after the frog). The fix makes a unit carrying 500952 a Beast in Unit::GetCreatureType. Control: the
Scare Beast attempt at the unfrogged humanoid is refused (12). Then a real Amphibimorph lands on the
dummy (1300 ms after its cast start), and the same attempt is accepted (no failure reason).
